record.paper_title: Ten Conferences WORDS: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: What is the length of the longest word avoiding strongly k-abelian nth powers?

evidence.quote: What is the length of the longest word avoiding strongly k-abelian nth powers?

artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in a list of open problems and conjectures from the WORDS conferences. Related work by Huova and Saarela introduces strongly k-abelian repetitions and shows certain avoidability results, but the precise length of the longest word avoiding strongly k-abelian nth powers does not appear to be determined in subsequent literature. No solution was located.

status_evidence.title: Strongly k-Abelian Repetitions
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces strongly k-abelian equivalence and considers avoidability of strongly k-abelian repetitions.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational paper defining the concept; the exact extremal length of words avoiding strongly k-abelian nth powers is posed as an open question.
